crew.overview: When danger threatens her camp, the fierce and highly skilled Comanche warrior Naru sets out to protect her people. But the prey she stalks turns out to be a highly evolved alien predator with a technically advanced arsenal.
crew.title: Prey

details.biography: Sharon McDonell is a Costume Designer & Artist living outside of Ottawa Ontario with an expansive resume.  She has worked as a Costume Designer (The Life and Hard Times of Guy Terrifico, The Maiden Danced to Death, Left Behind),  as Key Dresser (Prey, Suicide Squad, Shazam), as Personal Dresser (for both Peter O'Toole & Martin Short) and as a Textile Artist or Ager/Dyer (Pacific Rim).  She is a Member of I.A.T.S.E. Locals 873, 514 & 634.  Sharon also holds a BA in Film Studies from Queen's University and is an accomplished visual Artists.  She has been an 'Active Member' of the Federation of Canadian Artists since 2019.  (www.sharonmcdonell.com)
details.name: Sharon M. McDonell
